001package com.streamconverter.command;
002
003import java.io.IOException;
004import java.io.InputStream;
005import java.io.OutputStream;
006import org.slf4j.Logger;
007
008/**
009 * Unified interface for stream commands.
010 *
011 * <p>This interface defines methods for executing commands on input streams and writing results to
012 * output streams.
013 *
014 * <p>This is a functional interface and can be implemented using lambda expressions or method
015 * references for simple stream processing operations.
016 *
017 * <p><b>Note on lambda implementations:</b> Lambda and anonymous implementations are treated as
018 * synthetic by the JVM, so {@link #commandName()} returns {@code "IStreamCommand"} instead of a
019 * meaningful class name. {@link com.streamconverter.StreamConverter} wraps every command with
020 * {@link #withLogging(org.slf4j.Logger)}, so start/completion/failure log entries are emitted for
021 * all commands — including lambdas. However, the label used in those log entries is derived from
022 * {@link #commandName()}, which returns {@code "IStreamCommand"} for synthetic/lambda
023 * implementations. For commands that should appear in pipeline logs with a meaningful name,
024 * implement this interface as a named class or override {@link #commandName()}.
025 *
026 * <p>Usage examples:
027 *
028 * <pre>{@code
029 * // Simple copy operation (IOException is propagated from execute method signature)
030 * IStreamCommand copyCommand = (in, out) -> in.transferTo(out);
031 *
032 * // Buffered stream processing with custom logic
033 * IStreamCommand bufferCommand = (in, out) -> {
034 *     byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
035 *     int len;
036 *     while ((len = in.read(buffer)) != -1) {
037 *         out.write(buffer, 0, len);
038 *     }
039 * };
040 *
041 * // Using in StreamConverter pipeline
042 * StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(copyCommand);
043 * converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
044 * }</pre>
045 *
046 * <p><b>MDC への値の伝搬について:</b> {@code execute()} 内で {@code MDC.put()} を直接呼び出しても、
047 * 他コマンドのスレッドには伝搬されません。ストリームから抽出した値を全コマンドのログに反映させるには {@link
048 * com.streamconverter.command.rule.MdcPropagatingRule} を使用してください。子スレッドへの MDC 自動継承が必要な場合は {@link
049 * com.streamconverter.logging.MDCInitializer} を参照してください。
050 */
051@FunctionalInterface
052public interface IStreamCommand {
053
054  /**
055   * Executes the command on the provided input stream and writes the result to the output stream.
056   *
057   * @param inputStream The input stream to read data from.
058   * @param outputStream The output stream to write data to.
059   * @throws IOException If an I/O error occurs during the execution of the command.
060   */
061  void execute(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream) throws IOException;
062
063  /**
064   * Returns a best-effort human-readable name for this command.
065   *
066   * <p>Synthetic and anonymous implementations fall back to {@code IStreamCommand} so diagnostics
067   * remain stable even when the concrete class name is not meaningful.
068   *
069   * @return command label suitable for logging and error messages
070   */
071  default String commandName() {
072    Class<?> implClass = this.getClass();
073    if (implClass.isSynthetic()) {
074      return "IStreamCommand";
075    }
076    String simpleName = implClass.getSimpleName();
077    if (!simpleName.isEmpty()) {
078      return simpleName;
079    }
080    Class<?> superClass = implClass.getSuperclass();
081    if (superClass != null && !Object.class.equals(superClass)) {
082      String superName = superClass.getSimpleName();
083      if (!superName.isEmpty()) {
084        return superName;
085      }
086    }
087    return "IStreamCommand";
088  }
089
090  /**
091   * Wraps this command with logging. The returned command logs start, completion, and failure using
092   * the provided logger.
093   *
094   * <p>The command name is derived by {@link #commandName()}. When a caller wants a different label
095   * in logs, prefer {@link #withLogging(Logger, String)}.
096   *
097   * @param logger the logger to write messages to
098   * @return a new {@link IStreamCommand} that delegates to this command and emits log records
099   */
100  default IStreamCommand withLogging(Logger logger) {
101    return withLogging(logger, commandName());
102  }
103
104  /**
105   * Wraps this command with logging using an explicit command name.
106   *
107   * <p>This overload is recommended when the command is implemented as a lambda expression or
108   * method reference, where the underlying class name might be synthetic and not meaningful in
109   * logs.
110   *
111   * @param logger the logger to write messages to
112   * @param commandName the human-readable name of this command to appear in log messages
113   * @return a new {@link IStreamCommand} that delegates to this command and emits log records
114   */
115  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException")
116  // RuntimeException のキャッチは意図的: ロギング後に再スローするためで、握り潰しではない。
117  // Error は別ブロックで明示的に区別しており、汎用 Exception キャッチではない。
118  // PMD はルール定義上 RuntimeException を汎用キャッチと判定するため抑制が必要。
119  default IStreamCommand withLogging(Logger logger, String commandName) {
120    return (in, out) -> {
121      logger.info("Starting command: {}", commandName);
122      long start = System.currentTimeMillis();
123      try {
124        this.execute(in, out);
125        logger.info(
126            "Completed command: {} ({}ms)", commandName, System.currentTimeMillis() - start);
127      } catch (IOException | RuntimeException e) {
128        logger.error("Failed command: {} - {}", commandName, e.getMessage(), e);
129        throw e;
130      } catch (Error e) {
131        logger.error("Fatal error in command: {} - {}", commandName, e.getMessage(), e);
132        throw e;
133      }
134    };
135  }
136}
